title: BusinessOps Executive Report
description: A draft executive report assembled over one genuine strict synthesis set (ADR-0033). Eleven sections in fixed order, every one always present; one with nothing to show states empty, not_supplied or not_available. The report authors no analysis, recommendation or summary prose: every business statement is a synthesis statement, a class-7 record or a decision-package part, shown with its own confidence and materiality. Closed at every level: no score, weight, rank, priority, severity, likelihood, rating, target, owner, due date or execution state. Lifecycle is draft only until the M11 verifier defines final. The strategy_, swot_ and decision_ definitions are imported from strategy.schema.json, swot.schema.json and decision_support.schema.json and pinned to them by test. This schema checks shape; binding, digests, same-set identity and SWOT reconstruction are enforced by the executive_report engine, which is authoritative.

oneOf.description: A draft: unverified, carrying no verification record.
A final artifact: verified, with its verification record beside unedited content.

lifecycle.description: draft or final. executive_report.build() produces draft only; only verification.finalise() produces final, which changes the lifecycle fields and adds verification_record (ADR-0034).

human_decision.const: This is a draft report for people to read and decide on. BusinessOps assembled it from analysis already produced: it made no decision, recorded no approval and executes nothing. Acting on anything in it - a system write, a message, an export or an overwrite - needs a person's decision and explicit per-action approval, and financial transactions are prohibited.

verification_record.description: The verification a final artifact carries beside its unedited content (ADR-0034 section 8, ADR-0035 section 7). Present only when lifecycle is final.

decision_verification_record.description: The verification a final artifact carries beside its unedited content (ADR-0034 section 8, ADR-0035 section 7). Present only when lifecycle is final.

synthesis_digest.description: SHA-256 of the grounding synthesis set's serialisation when the recommendations were built: an identity for the exact evidence, not a copy of it.

empty_state.description: Null when recommendations were issued; the explicit empty state when none were.

quadrants.description: Always four, in the fixed order strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, threats. The order is presentation, not importance.

material_not_placed.description: Material statements in the set that no point placed, so an omission is visible rather than silent.

empty_state.description: Null when the quadrant holds points; the explicit empty state when it holds none.

oneOf.description: A draft: unverified, carrying no verification record.
A final artifact: verified, with its verification record beside unedited content.

lifecycle.description: draft or final. decision_support.build() produces draft only; only verification.finalise() produces final (ADR-0034).

synthesis_digest.description: SHA-256 of the grounding synthesis set's serialisation when the recommendations were built: an identity for the exact evidence, not a copy of it.

decision_objective.description: Stated by the user, or recorded as not stated. Never inferred.

decision_option.description: A course of action in presentation order. Only a recommendation option names a record; there is no score, weight or rank.

decision_criterion.description: What the user says matters. A configuration criterion names the resolved materiality key and its layer. There is no weight field.

decision_risk.description: A caution about one option. Evidence is optional; an unevidenced risk is LOW. There is no likelihood, severity or rating.

decision_guidance.description: Class-7 records and at most one preferred option. Either an option is preferred with its basis, or none is and the reason is stated.

decision_uncertainty.description: What is uncertain, missing or contested. A next step is an evidence gap the package carries; it has no owner, date or execution state.

decision_body.description: The twelve parts of ADR-0032, in order.

decision_request.description: What a skill passes to decision_support.build(). Closed: there is no field for confidence, support, trust, verification, lifecycle, weight, score, rank, priority, severity or likelihood. The engine is authoritative.

framing_text.description: One framing field as the user wrote it, or recorded as not stated. Never evidence.

statement_entry.description: One statement the report may rest on, shown verbatim with its own grounded detail.

kpi_statement_entry.description: A KPI statement. Prior, change and change % are the statement's own fields, never joined in or computed by the report.

anomaly_statement_entry.description: An anomaly statement, with the registered finding it resolves to. No cause and no label beyond what the engine stated.

observed.description: The finding's observed value, as the engine computed it.

baseline.description: The finding's comparison value: the baseline the deviation was measured against.

deviation.description: The finding's change from the baseline, as the engine computed it.

deviation_pct.description: The finding's change as a percentage of the baseline, as the engine computed it.

plain_detail.description: A statement shown but not rested on - an assumption, or a statement grounding refuses - with the reason.

decision_view.description: A package's question and guidance as the package states them, and nothing more.

section_reporting_frame.description: Set metadata and the user's framing. The quality warning comes before any figure.

availability.description: The status of sections 3 and 5-9, in section order (ADR-0033 section 4, item 7). Presentation, not a rating.

section_kpi_scorecard.description: One row per KPI the set registered, in catalogue order. No target, rating or colour.

section_outlook.description: Always not_available until a synthesis forecast translator is separately approved (ADR-0033 section 6).

reason.const: No forecast statement in this synthesis set carries forecast provenance.

section_evidence_and_uncertainty.description: Carried whole. The report computes no confidence of its own; each confidence is labelled with its owner.

section_decisions_for_the_reader.description: Open questions for a person. No action plan, owner, date, approval or execution state.

human_decision.const: This is a draft report for people to read and decide on. BusinessOps assembled it from analysis already produced: it made no decision, recorded no approval and executes nothing. Acting on anything in it - a system write, a message, an export or an overwrite - needs a person's decision and explicit per-action approval, and financial transactions are prohibited.

no_decision_recorded.const: BusinessOps has recorded no decision and no approval. Every question below is open until a person decides it.
